MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #11
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is √25? (1 mark)
   A. 12.5
   B. 6
   C. 25
   D. 5

2. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 25
   C. 2
   D. 24

3. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 121
   C. 122
   D. 11

4. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. 1/2
   C. 2/3
   D. 3/4

5. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 1

6. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 15.6
   C. 21
   D. 15.7

7. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 10
   C. 40
   D. 400

8. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x + 2
   B. 6x
   C. 12x
   D. 6x + 2

9. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 40 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 31
   C. 43
   D. 41

10. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 1000 m²
   B. 100 m²
   C. 10 000 m²
   D. 100 000 m²

11. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 2.5
   B. 0.25
   C. 0.205
   D. 0.025

12. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 0
   C. 8
   D. 16

13. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. Cannot tell
   C. They are equal
   D. 1/4

14. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 14
   C. 50
   D. 7

15. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 37
   D. 1

16. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 22
   C. 55
   D. 32

17. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 5
   C. 26
   D. 25

18. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 19
   C. 19.6
   D. 19.7

19. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 25
   C. 2
   D. 1

20. Solve for x: x + 9 = 21. (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 9
   C. 21
   D. 12

21. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.6
   B. 37
   C. 31.7
   D. 31

22. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 400
   C. 40
   D. 4

23. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 75
   C. 20
   D. 30

24. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 48
   C. 156
   D. 144

25. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 57
   C. 56
   D. 15

26. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 18
   C. 36
   D. 81

27. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 82
   C. 18
   D. 81

28. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 24
   C. 42
   D. 36

29. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.6
   B. 27.7
   C. 27
   D. 33

30. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 43
   C. 2
   D. 1

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
